issues.description: External specifications for slice pointer operations are placed in the generic std_extra module instead of the dedicated vstd_extra::external boundary.
issues.rationale: The selected head places trusted `assume_specification` declarations for `<[T]>::as_ptr` and `<[T]>::as_mut_ptr` in `vstd_extra::std_extra`. Review comment 4342695998 asks that these assumptions be moved into modules under `vstd_extra::external` to make the trust boundary clear. The author confirms the merge, and the final approved head moves the pointer assumptions verbatim to `vstd_extra/src/external/slice.rs` while moving the non-trusted range helpers to `external/range.rs`. This matches `centralize-trusted-boundaries`: unavoidable specifications for opaque standard-library APIs belong under the dedicated external-specification hierarchy.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Selected the latest PR head before the issue-comment timestamp, confirmed its real merge-base and fixed source, and compared the final approved head where the assumptions are moved into vstd_extra::external.
